purpose: Workflow for extracting requirements from Figma design files, building design tokens and a theme, and producing requirement documents for screens, components and functions.
summary: Required reading list of requirement principles, format, error classification, and style guides
Five-phase flow: preparation, design system, requirement writing, static assets, quality check
Phase 1 checks Figma MCP availability, confirms with the user, and retrieves rules and specs
Two-layer design system: design tokens and semantic themes, plus reusable component identification
Screen requirements (SCR) with screen-specific part names and ASCII layout diagrams
Component (CMP) and function (FNC) requirements, plus supplementing requirements absent from the design
Output location decision and ID numbering via next-spec-id
Static asset handling policy for icons, illustrations, logos and backgrounds
Quality checklists, AI review, specs index update, commit, and completion guidance
tasks: Creating requirement documents from a Figma design file
Design-first development of a new app
Redesigning an existing app using Figma
Defining screen and UI component requirements
Reviewing the start-requirements Figma mode workflow
title: Figma 要件定義書作成ワークフロー
